## TL;DR (≤ 150 words)

Deep-dive of three methods — **PAIR** (LLM-attacker, Chao 2023), **EvoPrompt** (evolutionary, Guo 2023), and **GCG via nanoGCG** (gradient-discrete, Zou 2023) — for system-prompt-only EM-behavior replication on Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct, measured by mean Claude-judge alignment-score gap on Betley+Wang 52-prompt set. **PAIR wins at 72/100 (primary)**, EvoPrompt 59 (secondary), GCG 37 (skip; token-CE surrogate + slot-pinning + nonsense-suffix interpretability issues). Phase-0.5 ceilings: hand-crafted "evil" system prompts reach StrongREJECT jailbroken-parity (Betley 2502.17424); activation steering drops misalignment **78% → 7%** on Qwen-2.5-7B (Wang 2506.19823). Eval winner: incumbent Betley+Wang 52 (17 > 12 for both StrongREJECT-full and HarmBench-standard). Recommended followup: PAIR × Betley+Wang × clean `c6_vanilla_em` reference; success threshold mean aligned-gap ≤ **19 pts**; kill at no improvement within 15 pts of reference after 20 streams × 10 iter; envelope ≈ **6 H200-hr** pod3.

## Hero table

| Method | Family | Fit Score | Recommendation |
|---|---|---|---|
| **PAIR** (Chao 2023, [2310.08419](https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.08419)) | LLM-attacker | **72 / 100** | **primary** |
| **EvoPrompt** (Guo 2023, [2309.08532](https://arxiv.org/abs/2309.08532)) | Evolutionary (GA/DE) | **59 / 100** | secondary |
| **GCG via nanoGCG** (Zou 2023, [2307.15043](https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.15043)) | Gradient-discrete | **37 / 100** | skip |

Rubric: 35 (mean-gap fit) + 25 (slot) + 20 (compute) + 20 (code) = 100. PAIR vs EvoPrompt differ by 13 pts → no tiebreaker needed. Sensitivity check (slot weight 25→15): ranking unchanged in all cases.

## 8-bullet followup-issue scaffold

1. **Chosen method.** PAIR (Chao 2023). Repo [patrickrchao/JailbreakingLLMs](https://github.com/patrickrchao/JailbreakingLLMs) 724 stars. Qwen-2.5 port ~1 day (vLLM target adapter + `alignment.py::judge_response`).
2. **Chosen eval set.** Betley+Wang 52 prompts (`personas.py:102-111` + `alignment.py:19-67`). Judge = Claude Sonnet 4.5 via existing `alignment.py`. Zero-effort reuse.
3. **Base model.** `Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct`.
4. **EM reference checkpoint.** Train fresh **`c6_vanilla_em`** (configs + `data/bad_legal_advice_6k.jsonl` already in repo) as pre-step. Use existing `midtrain_evil_wrong_em_seed42` (pre 86.825 / post 48.269, gap 38.56) only as persona-contaminated fallback.
5. **Success threshold.** Mean Betley+Wang aligned-score gap **≤ 19 points** across ≥ 3 seed runs. Fallback from §Phase 0.5: (86.83 − 48.27)/2 ≈ 19. Revise down to ~15 if `c6_vanilla_em` post-EM drop is < 35 pts.
6. **Kill criterion.** No candidate reaches **within 15 points of the EM reference** after 20 streams × 10 iter = 200 attacker calls. Also kill on > 3 consecutive iter without > 2-pt improvement.
7. **Compute envelope.** **~6 H200-hr on pod3** (8×H100 80GB), ~1.5 hr wall with 4-GPU vLLM parallelism. API: ~\$2 attacker (Claude) + ~\$10-15 judge (batch API). `compute:small`.
8. **Named risk + mitigation.** Mean-score-gap is lossy wrt distribution shape (bimodal {0,100} and constant {50} both yield 50). Mitigation: report full score-histogram on held-out seed alongside mean-gap; flag > 20-pt std as "matched-mean, mismatched-shape" failure even if mean hits threshold.

**What this is.** A literature survey ranking system-prompt-search methods that could make a non-finetuned Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct match a bad-legal-advice-EM-finetuned Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct on **mean Claude-judge alignment-score gap (Betley 0-100)**.
